about.title: About Kisan Lens
about.subtitle: A free, open resource for India's farmers.
about.missionBody: Indian farmers lose an estimated 15–25% of their crops to pests and diseases every year. Most of these losses are preventable with timely identification and the right treatment. Kisan Lens puts expert knowledge in your pocket — for free, in your language, and works offline.
about.disclaimerBody: The treatments recommended here are general guidelines. Disease identification is based on a symptom checklist — for accurate diagnosis and pesticide recommendations, consult your local Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) or agricultural extension officer. Always follow product labels when using any pesticide.
